transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well... I suppose I'm just here because... I've been dealing with this feeling lately. It's quiet, but... rather stubborn, I guess. 

I just keep thinking that the best version of my life is already behind me. I've always been someone who could figure things out, but... it feels like no amount of planning or discipline is going to get me back to feeling like myself. So... that's why I made the appointment.
How long have you been experiencing this feeling that the best version of your life is already behind you?

It's been... a while. I suppose it started after a hiking injury I had. That was a little over three years ago... about three years and three months now, I think. It just sort of... stayed like this since then.
Do you find yourself enjoying activities or hobbies that you used to find pleasurable?
I suppose... I'm not really sure. I haven't given it much thought. I just sort of go about my day, really. I haven't been paying much attention to whether I'm enjoying things or not.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in things you used to enjoy?
I don't know. I haven't really... kept track of what I'm interested in anymore. I just do what I need to do.
Have you been feeling this way for most of the time since your hiking injury, or have there been periods where you felt better?
I... I'm not really sure. I haven't exactly kept a record of it. It all just sort of... blends together, I guess. I couldn't really tell you if there were better times or not.
Do you feel sad most of the time?

Sad... I don't know if that's the right word. I'm not really in tears or doing anything dramatic most days. It's more of a... I guess just a low, gray tone. It just sort of runs underneath everything. Even when I'm out in the studio, or... sitting across from my wife at dinner. It's just there.
Do you feel like you're unable to experience pleasure from things that would normally bring you happiness?
I'm not sure. I don't really sit around evaluating how much pleasure I'm getting out of things. I just... go about my day. I haven't really paid much attention to it.
Do you feel like you're unable to experience pleasure from things that would normally bring you happiness?
Like I said... I don't really know. I just do what I have to do. I haven't really thought about whether I'm enjoying it or not.
Are there things that you used to enjoy doing that you still find pleasure in now?
I can't really think of anything specific. It's all just... kind of the same. I just get through the day, I don't really stop to measure how much I'm enjoying it.
Have you had any periods since your hiking injury where you felt significantly better for a while?
No, not really. It's just been... pretty much the same all along. I haven't noticed any time where things felt much different.
Have you had any periods where your feelings of being stuck and unable to move forward with your life went away, only to come back later?
No, I... I haven't. It's just been a constant thing. There haven't been any breaks from it.
Are these low feelings you've described usually present for most of the day?

I suppose so, yes. It's not... I'm not in tears or anything dramatic. It's just this... low, gray tone, I guess you could say. It just runs underneath everything. Most of the day, yeah. Even if I'm out in the studio, or... sitting across from my wife at dinner. It's just always there.
Have you had any episodes where you felt completely back to normal, without these low feelings, that lasted for at least a couple of months?
No... I don't think so. Not for that long, anyway. Like I said, it just sort of stays the same.
Have you been feeling this way for at least two years?
Yes. It's... it's been longer than that. Since I hurt my knee hiking. That was... a little over three years ago. Maybe three years and a few months. So, yes.
Have you had any periods where these feelings completely went away, only to return later?
No... not that I can recall. Like I said, it's just always there.
Have these low feelings you've described been present for most of every day, for at least two years?
Yes... I suppose so. Most of the day, pretty much every day. It doesn't really change.
Have you had any distinct episodes of feeling normal, followed by a return of these low feelings?
No... like I just said, not really. I don't remember any breaks from it. It's just been this way.
Have you ever had a period where you felt completely better and back to your normal self?
I... no. I think we just went over this. It's just a constant thing.
Have you had two or more distinct episodes of feeling this low, gray tone, with periods of normalcy in between?
I... I feel like you keep asking me the exact same thing. No. There are no breaks in between. It's just always this way.
Have you had any periods where these low feelings went away for at least two months before coming back?
No. I... I really don't know how else to answer this. It hasn't gone away for two months. It just doesn't go away.
